From brief to running ads in five steps

You send a product and a few lines about your customer. We handle everything between that and a finished ad.

STEP 01

You send the product & brief

Ship us the product (real-creator ads) and tell us who it’s for and what it fixes. AI ads need only the brief.

STEP 02

We write the hook + script

Problem → product → result, in the creator’s own voice. The first line is written to stop the scroll in 2 seconds.

STEP 03

Creator films — or AI generates

A matched creator films it on their phone, or an AI avatar performs the script. Raw, natural, believable.

STEP 04

We edit it into an ad

Fast cuts, captions, product close-ups and a clear call to action — cut for the feed, not for TV.

STEP 05

You get variations to run

Finished 9:16 videos, ready to upload to Instagram, Facebook or TikTok Ads. Different hooks, so you can test what converts.

Why brands are moving budget from commercials to UGC

Real > polished

People trust people

A polished commercial gets scrolled past like every other ad. A real person, in their own room, saying “this actually worked for me” gets watched — and believed.

0–2s

The hook decides everything

Feeds are won or lost in the first two seconds. Every script we write opens with the problem, a pattern-break or a bold claim — never a logo, never “introducing…”

5–7 days

Fast enough to test weekly

No studio bookings, no month-long productions. Brief to finished ads in 5–7 days, so you can test new hooks every week and scale the ones that sell.

The playbook: AI finds the winner, real creators scale it

Start with an AI test pack and run two different hooks. The hook that converts gets remade with a real creator — higher trust, same proven angle. Cheap testing, premium scaling.
